name: v1.21.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Fix beacon spam compatibility and prepare v1.20.1 by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1695
* Start the Waveshare C5 3.5 display dark, no static at boot by @slickrick773 in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1691
* Fix Evil Portal cleanup on headless targets by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1700
* fix: preserve targeted EAPOL captures by @pavelzaitsau in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1696
* Add framed SD file streaming over serial by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1701
* Promote validated v1.20.1 fixes to master by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1702
* Bump firmware version to v1.21.0 by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1703
* Promote v1.21.0 to master by @justcallmekoko in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1704

## New Contributors
* @pavelzaitsau made their first contribution in https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/pull/1696

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/compare/v1.20.0...v1.21.0

[justcallmekokollc.com](https://justcallmekokollc.com)

## Before installing

- Match the complete hardware name and binary suffix. Do not substitute a binary merely because two devices use the same ESP32 family.
- See [Install/Update Instructions](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/wiki/update-firmware) for the supported flashing methods.
- See [GPS Modification](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/wiki/gps-modification) when adding GPS to compatible hardware.
- Flipper Zero users should install the current [Marauder Companion](https://github.com/0xchocolate/flipperzero-wifi-marauder/releases/latest).

> **Flipper hardware:** Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board and Marauder Dev Board Pro/BFFB use different firmware targets.

> **Marauder v6:** Check the revision printed on the screen side of the PCB. Use `_v6.bin` for v6 and `_v6_1.bin` for v6.1/v6.2.

## Firmware assets

| Hardware | Release binary |
| --- | --- |
| Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board (Flipper Zero, WiFi Dev Board) | `_flipper.bin` |
| Flipper Zero Multi Board S3 (MultiBoard S3, Multiboard S3) | `_multiboardS3.bin` |
| OG Marauder (Marauder v4, Old hardware) | `_old_hardware.bin` |
| Marauder v6 (New hardware) | `_v6.bin` |
| Marauder v6.1 (Marauder v6.2, AWOK V2 screen, AWOK V3 screen) | `_v6_1.bin` |
| Marauder Kit | `_kit.bin` |
| Marauder Mini | `_mini.bin` |
| ESP32 LDDB (NodeMCU, Wemos) | `_esp32_lddb.bin` |
| Marauder Dev Board Pro (BFFB, AWOK V3 flipper) | `_marauder_dev_board_pro.bin` |
| M5StickC Plus | `_m5stickc_plus.bin` |
| M5StickC Plus 2 | `_m5stickc_plus2.bin` |
| M5Stack Core2 for AWS (Core2 for AWS, AWS IoT EduKit, M5Stack Core2 AWS) | `_m5stack_core2_aws.bin` |
| ESP32-S2 Reverse Feather (Rev Feather) | `_rev_feather.bin` |
| Marauder v7 | `_marauder_v7.bin` |
| Marauder CYD 2432S028 (CYD 2432S028R) | `_cyd_2432S028.bin` |
| Marauder CYD 2432S024 GUITION (RL Phantom) | `_cyd_2432S024_guition.bin` |
| Marauder CYD 2432S028 2 USB | `_cyd_2432S028_2usb.bin` |
| Marauder CYD 3.5 inch | `_cyd_3_5_inch.bin` |
| M5 Cardputer | `_m5cardputer.bin` |
| M5 Cardputer ADV | `_m5cardputer_adv.bin` |
| ESP32-C5-DevKitC-1 (ESP32-C5 DevKit, BFFB V2, C5 Lowkey, Marauder C5 Adapter) | `_esp32c5devkitc1.bin` |
| Seeed XIAO ESP32-C5 (XIAO ESP32-C5, XIAO C5) | `_xiao_esp32c5.bin` |
| LilyGo T-Dongle C5 (T-Dongle C5, T Dongle C5) | `_t_dongle_c5.bin` |
| M5 Nano C6 (M5NanoC6) | `_m5nanoc6.bin` |
| Marauder Pancake (Pancake Marauder V8) | `_pancake.bin` |
| Waveshare ESP32-C5-Touch-LCD-3.5 (Waveshare ESP32-C5-Touch-LCD-3.5, WS C5 3.5) | `_ws_c5_35.bin` |
| POOM (Stellar IoT POOM) | `_poom.bin` |
| Marauder v8 | `_v8.bin` |
| Marauder Mini v3 (Mini v3) | `_mini_v3.bin` |
| Dual Mini C5 (Dual C5 Mini) | `_dual_mini_c5.bin` |

ESP32-C5 targets require their documented flash layout. See the [ESP32-C5 guide](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/wiki/ESP32%E2%80%90C5%E2%80%90DevKitC%E2%80%901) and [Supported Hardware](https://github.com/justcallmekoko/ESP32Marauder/wiki/Supported-Hardware).
